Rahul Gandhi Supports Protesting Tribal Students in Nashik

Rahul Gandhi met with protesting tribal students in Nashik, Maharashtra, to support their demands regarding Adivasi identity and rights. During the event, Gandhi claimed that the RSS and BJP intend to redefine tribal people as 'Vanvasis'. The Maharashtra government has since conceded to the students' demands. In a separate context, Gandhi has also been called upon to extend his vision of gender justice to include Indian Muslim youth to address patriarchy within that community.
